ai-detector.name: Academic Wizard Linguistic AI Detector
ai-detector.tagline: Free AI Content & Academic Integrity Detector for University Essays
ai-detector.short_description: Instant linguistic AI detector analyzing perplexity and sentence burstiness to verify student essays against false Turnitin flags. 100% free with zero data logging.
ai-detector.full_description:
Academic Wizard's Linguistic AI Detector is an essential academic integrity companion engineered specifically for higher education students and researchers.

As universities worldwide increasingly rely on automated AI detection software, human-written academic prose is frequently misidentified due to formal phrasing and objective syntax. Academic Wizard's tool addresses this challenge by analyzing sentence-level perplexity, linguistic burstiness, and syntactic predictability in real-time.

Key Capabilities:
• Multi-Sentence Perplexity Scoring: Pinpoints exact paragraphs with uniform phrasing likely to trigger false positive flags.
• Strict Non-Repository Policy: Your text is never stored, indexed, or shared with third-party databases, ensuring complete academic privacy.
• Academic Convention Awareness: Calibrated for formal coursework, lab reports, and literature reviews across UK, US, Canadian, and Australian university standards.
• Instant Color-Coded Heatmaps: Visual breakdown of human vs. algorithmic syntax patterns for targeted editing.

Whether preparing an undergraduate assignment, a postgraduate dissertation chapter, or a journal submission, Academic Wizard provides the transparency and confidence students need before hitting submit.
key_features: Calibrated for APA, Harvard, and formal academic prose
No account or credit card required

ai-humanizer.name: Academic Wizard AI Text Humanizer
ai-humanizer.tagline: Transform AI-Assisted Writing into Natural Academic Prose
ai-humanizer.short_description: Free academic text humanizer that introduces authentic syntactic variance, varied sentence cadence, and natural authorial flow while preserving scholarly rigor.
ai-humanizer.full_description:
Academic Wizard's AI Text Humanizer helps students and scholars refine their drafts by eliminating robotic rhythms, repetitive transitions, and formulaic sentence structures.

Modern AI writing tools tend to generate uniform, predictable sentence structures that sound mechanical. Academic Wizard's humanizer restructures monotonous clauses, varies vocabulary, and injects dynamic academic cadence while preserving your core thesis, factual data, and primary references intact.

Key Capabilities:
• Academic Voice Preservation: Maintains sophisticated scholarly tone without dumbing down specialized arguments.
• Structural Variance Injection: Combines short punchy sentences with compound analytical clauses to eliminate burstiness flags.
• Active Citation Protection: Keeps in-text references (APA 7th, Harvard, OSCOLA, Chicago) uncorrupted during rewriting.
• 100% Free & Unlimited: No daily limits or subscriptions.
key_features: Natural academic cadence and burstiness injection
Preserves specialized citations and academic vocabulary
